summary: NTS Eindhoven. Not found in the IND sponsor register. 100% of its 2 jobs here don't ask for Dutch.

insights.one_liner: NTS develops, builds and assembles high-tech systems for semiconductor and analytical equipment makers, with engineering internships in Nijmegen.

culture.text: It combines development, production and assembly to build systems for advanced semiconductor and analytical customers.
Its 2 open jobs here are both engineering internships in Nijmegen; one shows pay.

open.text: NTS is not listed as an IND recognised sponsor.
Both current postings are open to people who don't speak Dutch.
NTS Group B.V. is owned by Dutch holding company Highlands Beheer B.V.
